This is a quick little 1.6 remake of Gotama's "Scarecrow and Hats MOD" (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1314) made with Content Patcher since it has been abandoned by its developer. It also cuts out the scarecrows and hats, leaving just the fat boy horse retexture.


this was inspired by this Reddit post: https://www.reddit.com/r/StardewValley/comments/1jnxub0/this_has_been_haunting_me_for_3_years_since_may/ (i have retured your round son :3)
